title: Frozen

You're frozen

(If I could melt your heart)
(We'd never be apart)

(We'd never be apart)

(We'd never be apart)
Give yourself to me
(We'd never be apart)

(If I could melt your heart)
(We'd never be apart)
If I could melt your heart
(We'd never be apart)
